sources.rule: A file of the tip tree is admitted iff (a) every commit that touched its path (git log --no-renames --full-history) is the squash merge on main of a PR listed in passed (Auditor PASS at the exact merged head, evidence named); (b) its extension is code or text (ts mts cts js mjs cjs py sh md); (c) its path is not junk (lb-clean JUNK_PATH), not a fixture dir, not .github, and names nothing held-out, hidden, Results, task-set, exclusion, drop-hash, nl-pairs or verdict related; (d) its text holds no 40-64 hex run (a pinned hash) and is valid UTF-8. Anything not attributable this way is excluded. Peace's own verdicts: none are admitted in v1 (they live in Results, which is excluded). (e) Dev-task rule (Auditor #673 B1): no new TRAIN doc may name, diagnose or encode the fix of a public dev task of peaceai/plan/tasks-public-v1.json (lbcorpus2.ts devTaskHits: dev_name, dev_span, dev_sha, dev_fix against the pinned set and devfix files). Each admitted file that hits has a decision in devTasks.decisions: drop (it encodes or describes a dev fix, or lb-clean already drops it) or heldout_v2 (it only names dev tasks or reports their run status); a build refuses an undecided or stale hit, and refuses when any new train doc still hits.
